description_en: Modifies the rule information of a hybrid cloud cluster
description_zh: 修改混合云集群规则信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-hybrid-cloud-cluster-rule --instance-id waf-cn-n6w000x52m --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHybridCloudClusterRule

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The resource ID of the cluster rule
parameters.name: cluster_rule_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The traffic redirection rule configuration.

<notice>The mode cannot be modified.</notice>
check_mode: the mode. Valid values:
all: full traffic redirection.
part: partial traffic redirection.
type: the rule matching type. Valid values:
exact: exact match.
regex: regular expression.
substance: the rule value
parameters.help_zh:
引流规则配置：

<notice>模式选择不允许修改</notice>
check_mode 模式选择 取值：
all：全量引流
part：指定部分引流
type：规则匹配类型取值：
exact：精准
regex：正则
substance：规则值>
parameters.name: rule_config

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值范围如下：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
[Deprecated] The rule type. Valid values:
pullin: traffic redirection configuration
parameters.help_zh:
【废弃】规则类型。取值范围如下：
pullin ：引流配置
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The rule status. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态。取值范围如下：
on：开启。
off ：关闭
parameters.name: rule_status
